name: Kesoram Industries Ltd
about: Kesoram Industries Limited is a flagship company of B. K. Birla group. The Co is engaged in the manufacturing of Cement and Rayon, TP & Chemicals. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
Cement (94% in FY24 vs 98% in FY22)- It manufactures cement under the brand “Birla Shakti Cement”. It sells premium cement under the brand “Birla Shakti ConQUerete”.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.48 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 99.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 491%
Debtor days have improved from 258 to 45.6 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -37.2% over past five years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
